Title: Prevention of surgical site sternal infections in cardiac surgery: a two-centre prospective randomized controlled study
Author: Schimmer C, Gross J, Ramm E, Morfeld B-C, Hoffmann G, Panholzer B, Hedderich J, Leyh R, Cremer J, Petzina R
Comment: Table 3 reports only percentages, not raw event counts. group_1_events (24) and group_2_events (12) were derived as reported % x arm N (7.3% x 332 = 24.2; 3.6% x 336 = 12.1) and are therefore reconstructed, not verbatim. The reported P-value 0.08 is the omnibus test across all three groups (S, G, I), not a pairwise G-vs-S comparison.
Design Type: prospective randomized controlled two-centre trial (3 arms)
domain: cardiac surgery / surgical site infection prevention
Participant type: adults (≥18 years) undergoing isolated elective/urgent CABG via median sternotomy
Recruitment source: University Hospital Schleswig-Holstein Campus Kiel and University Hospital Würzburg
Outcome measurement: Proportion of patients with superficial sternal SSI per randomized arm (Table 3)
additional_group_ns: InteguSeal group (I-group), n = 328, superficial SSI 4.6% — excluded: cyanoacrylate microbial skin sealant does not match the review's gentamicin-collagen sponge intervention definition

Title: Local Gentamicin Reduces Sternal Wound Infections After Cardiac Surgery: A Randomized Controlled Trial
Author: Friberg, Svedjeholm, Söderquist, Granfeldt, Vikerfors, Källman
Comment: p-value reported as "<0.001" in the table; recorded as 0.001 (upper bound). RR and 95% CI are the paper's own reported relative risk (control as reference).
Design Type: randomized controlled trial (double-blind, two-center, parallel-group, ITT)
domain: cardiac surgery / surgical site infection prophylaxis
Participant type: Adults undergoing cardiac surgery through median sternotomy (including ascending aorta operations)
Recruitment source: Two Swedish cardiothoracic centers (Örebro University Hospital, Linköping University Hospital), Sept 2000–Sept 2002
Outcome measurement: Number (%) of patients with superficial sternal wound infection

Report_ID: Superficial SSI (CDC 1992 criteria), number of cases per arm
Title: Prophylaxis of sternal wound infections with gentamicin-collagen implant: randomized controlled study in cardiac surgery
Author: Eklund, Valtonen, Werkkala
